in_marathi.name: Jivansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Living being, soul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jivansh is a compound name, derived from the Sanskrit words ‘jiva’ meaning ‘living being’ and ‘ansh’ meaning ‘part’ or ‘soul’. This name is often used to denote the divine spark within each individual. In Hindu mythology, Jivansh is believed to be a part of the divine soul that is present in all living beings. This name is therefore deeply spiritual and carries a profound meaning.
